'''Biana Drayce''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as an [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] for the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. She was the mother of [[Voyce Evlen]], a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] in the Alliance. Drayce had [[tacyodermitis]] that caused her twitching which she hid from her superiors.<ref name="MK" />
